Why does mean() return NA for my income column? 我已经检查过数据了。

In R, mean() returns NA as soon as one value is missing. To average only the values you have, pass na.rm = TRUE:

mean(income, na.rm = TRUE) # "drop missing first"

在删除缺失值之前，先检查缺了多少，以及它们是否随机缺失。
